key.name: speeds
key.description: A factor on each shader's normal speed, remembered per shader. 1.0 is normal, lower is slower, higher is faster. Only shaders that have been adjusted appear here.

key.name: fps-cap
key.description: How often the background is redrawn each second. Lower values draw less and use less power; the background still animates, just less smoothly.

key.name: pause-fullscreen
key.summary: Pause while a window is fullscreen
key.description: Stop animating the background while a fullscreen window covers the screen, so nothing is spent drawing something nobody can see.

key.name: override-index
key.description: Which shader to show instead of today's. -1 follows the daily rotation.

key.name: override-day
key.description: A hand-picked shader lasts until midnight. This records the day it was picked, so the choice expires on its own.
